tei:div.tei:p: ྈ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig las: drag po'i lha gsum gyi las byang snang srid dregs pa kun 'dul bzhugs so: yan lag gi sgrub skor : ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ na mo kro dha siddhi hūm̐: skye med ngang las 'gag med 'bar ba'i sku: dregs 'dul drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: da lta 'dzam gling lha 'dre gdug pa can: 'dul ba'i lha gcig padma thod phreng ngas: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus kyi mthar: mi rnams log spyod sna tshogs rkyen dag gis: lha 'dre kun 'khrugs mi phyugs srog la 'khu: mi rung sna dgu nad rigs rlung ltar 'tshubs: shin tu mi bzad nyon mongs nyams thag tshe: ma rungs lha 'dre gdug pa gang yang rung: kun 'dul gcig chog drag po'i lha gsum gyi: sgrub thabs zab mo snying khrag dwangs 'di bkod: da lta pha nor ma 'ongs bu yi chos: srung ma gsum bcol dmu rdor rgya yi thems: sa ma yā: phrin las gzhung bsrang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa bka' bsgo mtshams: skyabs sems yan lag byin 'beb mchod brlab bshags: gnyis pa dngos gzhi dam tshig bskyed pa dang: ye shes spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod: bstod bshags dzap dang tshogs kyi las rim mo: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim bskul nas kyang: chad mdo gtor zor brtan skyong gtor bro brdung: tshe 'gugs dngos grub shis brjod dkyil 'khor bsdu: bsngo ba smon lam dmigs med rgyas gdab bo: sa ma yā: thog mar bsgrub pa'i lag len sta gon bstan: drag po'i bsgrub gnas gnam sa chos 'byung dbyibs: dur khrod sa 'am shin tu dben pa'i sar: sa dpyad sa bslang cho ga rgyas pa ni: spyi dang mthun ste sa mdog dmar zhing nag: snum pa'i sa la maṇḍal mda' gang la: rakta chang dang dri bzang bsres pa'i chus: chag chag gdab ste rkyang nul legs par bya: bcu drug thig sogs tshangs zur logs thig rnams: cha chen cha phran rim pa spyi mthun gdab:

lte bar sa bon chos 'byung dmar nag nang: phyi rim mu khyud gsum bskor thod phreng dbus: zla gam sngon po rtsibs bzhi phyogs mdog mchan: mthing ga phyi rim rtsibs bcu mthing nag bya: rtsibs mchan dmar po de rgyab thod phreng bskor: sgo gru rta babs chos 'khor gdugs tog sogs: dur khrod padma rdor ra me ri rnams: dkyil 'khor spyi mthun bri tshon legs par bya: sa ma yā: de steng mañdzi'i khri yi khar: bhandha mtshan ldan dum gcig pa: lcang lo can gnyis kha sbyor nang: drag po'i lha gsum snying po bri: rta phyag khyung gsum ril bus bkang: dar gyis legs par dril nas bzhag: de steng rkang gsum mthon po'i khar: gser ram zangs lcags snod nang du: rten gtor gru gang stod zur can: me ri 'bar brgyan mar nag byugs: steng du khyung sku bzos 'bag gam: mi shes bris sku tsaka li gzug: de steng dar nag gur chen phub: 'khor du dmar gtor rkang gang bzhi: de rgyab mtho gang bcu yis bskor: dkar dmar rdzas kyis legs par brgyan: gzhan yang sku gsung thugs la sogs: 'bral med rten rnams legs par bkod: spyi mthun rtsa gsum gtor ma dang: phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor: tshogs gtor spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang: bca' dang bza' btung bye brag rnams: dkar gyi thig gdab dmar gur phub: dkyil 'khor mchod gtor rim pa rnams: mdzes shing yid 'ong snang ba 'phrog: bag dro rgyan ldan chal mar bshams: bsang sbyang byin rlabs ldan par bya: sa ma yā: de nas phyi rgyud dkar gtor gtang: nang rgyud dmar la dga' ba rnams: sha khrag brgyan pa'i dmar gtor 'bul: bgegs gtor ting lo changs bu bcas: a kā ro yis byin gyis brlab: bgegs la byin zhing bka' bsgo ni: rang nyid drag por bzhengs nas kyang: lha yi nga rgyal ting 'dzin bskyed: sha chen spos dang gu gul bsreg: sgrub khang rdo ril thun gyis brab: mched lcam sngags pa'i chas ldan zhing:

rol mo sna tshogs 'ur chem rjes: khros pa'i rngam gyer 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrī: nga ni dpal chen rta phyag khyung gsum lha: dregs 'dul drag po gsang chen bsgrub gnas 'dir: skal med bdud bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: bden pa'i tshig nyon ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te drag po 'bar ba'i bka' 'das na: bdag nyid thugs khros sgo gsum 'gem par byed: de bas byin zas zo la gzhan dengs shig: oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐: gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐: gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān bidyā rā dza kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid khro rgyal drag po lha gsum gyi: sku las 'od zer me dpung mtshon cha'i char: rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrigs pa'i rtse phyir bstan: rdo rje hūm̐ yig rang 'dra'i khro tshogs khyung: steng 'og phyogs mtshams srung ba'i gur khang la: sra brtan 'gyur med gzhom gzhig med par gtams: badzra tsakra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag sogs dus 'di nas gzung byang chub bar: skyabs gnas mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi: pha ma 'gro drug sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: kun kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong sprugs nas: ma lus smin grol sangs rgyas thob par shog: yan lag bdun pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang snang drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub mchod par 'bul: gnyis 'dzin rang ngo ma shes mthol lo bshags: rang snang 'bral med ngang du yi rang ngo: gsal khyab nus rtsal rdzogs pa'i chos 'khor bskor: dam ye dbyer med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: bskyed rdzogs gnyis med chos dbyings klong du bsngo: zung 'jug bde chen kun bzang nyid thob shog: byin 'beb ni: hūm̐ hrī: yi dam dpal chen rta phyag khyung gsum lha: chos kyi dbyings nas brtse ba'i skur bzhengs la:

gnas 'dir byin phob ye shes dbang mchog skur: skal ldan bdag cag sgrub pa'i bar chad sol: dregs pa lha srin 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: badzra sa ma ya ā we sha ya a ā: mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang bzhin dgongs rgyud ye dag stong pa'i ngang: dbyings kyi snod du ye shes bdud rtsis bltams: stong nyid bhan dhar rang gsal raktas bkang: snang ba gtor gzhong srid tshad gtor mar bshams: stong gsum lha rdzas phyi mchod rnam lnga dang: rang byung 'dod yon lnga yi sprin dpung gtib: gnyis med bde chen byang sems mchod pa'i rgyun: dkyil 'khor lha yi longs spyod bsam mi khyab: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta pū tsa sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widya shabda rū pa shabda gandhe ra sya sparshe bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha pū tsa ho: bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang snang ye shes drag po'i lha mchog gsum: ye nas rang rig ngo bor dbyer med kyang: ma rig gnyis rtog sgrib pa'i dri ma rnams: sku gsung thugs dang 'gal gyur mthol lo bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe a: gnyis pa dngos gzhi dam tshig bskyed pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsum ting 'dzin rnam gsum rol pa las: cir yang mi dmigs stong pa de nyid ngang: gnam sa gnam lcags las grub 'khor lo gnyis: rtsibs bcu kha sbyor g.yas g.yon 'ur chem 'khor: bar du gnod byed sha rus phye mar 'thag: rtsibs nang khro bcu'i pho nya rnams kyis gsol: lte bar 'byung ba lnga yi dkyil 'khor steng: rang byung gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs ldan dbus: ye shes me dud 'bar 'khrigs gur khang klong: lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ma'i dbus: dregs pa lha srin khyo shug bsnol ba'i khrir: paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng: rgyu yi sa bon hrīḥyig 'phro 'du las: bdag nyid rta mgrin che mchog dmar nag 'khrugs:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig khro tshul gzigs: shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin zhal nas phaṭaḥsgra sgrog: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb: spyi gtsug ral pa kham nag me 'bar gseb: rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma le brgan 'bar: khams gsum dbang sdud rta skad dbyings su 'tsher: thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal 'phyang: mi lpags glang ko stag sham sbrul chun dang: rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: srid gsum zil gnon dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams: dmar nag me klong gar dgu'i nyams ldan bskyed: thugs kar tsitta rin chen 'bar ba'i dbus: pad nyir hūm̐ las rang rig phyag rdor mthing: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: spyan gsum sdang mig dbu skra gyen du 'bar: klu 'dul sbrul rigs lnga yis sku la brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar gdengs: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse la me 'bar bsgrengs: zhabs gnyis me klong 'gyings bag tshul du bskyed: spyi gtsug khroṃ las bya khyung ga ru ṭa: mthing nag me gshog gnam lcags rwa bar du: nor bu nyi zla gser mig rdo rje'i mchu: spu gri'i so dang lcags kyu'i sder mo can: klu rnams bred cing dug sbrul zhal du gsol: spu sprugs rdo rje'i thog char phyogs kun 'khrigs: phyogs bzhir sprul pa'i khyung chen rigs bzhi yang: dkar ser dmar ljang cha lugs gtso dang mthun: de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng: rigs bzhi'i rta mgrin dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: rang rtags phyag mtshan yu ba'i ral gri g.yas: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs gtso bor zhal gzigs nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrub par byed: de rgyab rtsibs bcur sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu: sku mdog sna tshogs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:

dpal chas rab 'jigs rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin: zhal rnams phyir gzigs hūm̐ phaṭa sngags sgra sgrog: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal dang ldan: me 'bar gnod byed snying khar bro brdungs pas: gzhob tu bsregs nas ming med brlag par byed: kun kyang me 'bar gar gyi nyams ldan bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: 'jigs rung dur khrod gsang chen pho brang nas: drag po mi bsrun rta phyag khyung gsum lha: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir dad pas spyan 'dren no: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: dza: chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu mar skur bzhengs la: sngon gyi rang rang thugs dam ci bzhin du: ma rungs gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: nag po klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bsen 'gong the'u rang 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gnyan lhog smyo 'bog 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dregs pa gza' rgod 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: pe dkar srog bdag 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: nad yams mu ge bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: snang srid bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: drag po gsang chen pho brang nyams re dga': sgrub mchog rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang: bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor yid 'ong bkrag re che: bshams pa'i mchod rdzas bcud ldan dang re spro: gdan mchog khri brtsegs brjid ldan bag re dro: drag po'i lha tshogs dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang snang rtsal rdzogs drag po'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rang rig rtse gcig gus pas thal sbyar nas:

rang gsal 'gag med ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: 'bral med yid bzhin dngos grub bstsal du gsol: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: dregs 'dul rta phyag khyung gsum lha tshogs la: lha rdzas rnam lnga phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: rang byung 'dod yon nang gi mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med gsang ba'i byang sems mchod pa 'bul: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: nyon mongs kun bsgral rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: bcud mchog dpal gtor rgyan ldan mchod pa 'bul: dug lnga dug gsum rang grol mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol gnyis med ting 'dzin mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra arghaṃ pa dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widya shabda rū pa shabda gandhe ra sya sparshe a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta sarba pū tsa la khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: gdod nas kun bzang bde chen rtsal rdzogs lha: che mchog dmar nag dbang chen drag po rtsal: dpal gyi chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: phyag g.yas ral gris dgra bgegs dum bur gtub: g.yon pas lcags kyus gnod byed snying nas 'dren: spyi gtsug ral gseb rta skad dbyings su 'tsher: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud zil gyis gnon: rta mgrin gtso 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: gsang bdag drag po mthu stobs kun gyi bdag: mi bsrun rngam brjid mthing nag dur khrod chas: klu rnams 'dul phyir sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rjes sde brgyad klad pa 'gem: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse la me 'bar bas: sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon zhing sreg: dregs 'dul phyag rdor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ khroṃ: khro rgyal khyung chen mthing nag me gshog rdeb: gnam lcags rwa la rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchu: spu gri'i mche gtsigs lcags kyu'i sder mo can: klu rigs ma lus brad cing zas su za: spyi gtsug nor bu nyi zla gser mig 'khyil:

krang kring sgrog cing spu rnams sprugs pa las: rdo rje'i thog char khams gsum phyogs kun 'khrigs: ri rab bsnyil zhing nyi zla tsog por 'phen: dpal chen dag dang dgongs pa mnyam par bzhugs: khro rgyal khyung chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: dpal chen gtso mchog thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur las: gang la gang 'dul 'jigs tshul cir yang ston: bar chad bdud dpung dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i gnyen: khro bcu 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: bshags pa ni: ho: yi dam rta phyag khyung gsum lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i lus ngag sems: khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang ci 'gal ba: gnod zhing 'gyod pas mthol bshags dag par mdzod: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya= dzap ni: bdag nyid che mchog drag po lha gsum gyi: thugs kar nyi steng sa bon sngags phreng 'khor: dmar nag 'bar 'khrigs rang sgra 'od dang bcas: zer 'phros me dud 'bar zhing rab tu mched: rtse mo shin tu rno ngar tsha la rtsub: mi bzad skar ltar 'khrugs pas phyogs kun khyab: snang srid khams kyi ma rungs gdug pa can: dregs pa lha srin pho mo gzir zhing sreg: ma lus gtan nas tshar bcad dbang du sdud: nus mthu srog snying tshur 'dus rang nyid kyi: thugs kar nyi dbus sa bon zhabs su tshud: rang nyid sngar las bkrag mdangs cher rgyas shing: mthu stobs gzi byin dpa' brjid ldan par bsam: rtsa sngags rgyas pa ni: āom̐ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: rta mgrin gyi snying po 'o: āom̐ badzra pā ṇi tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: phyag rdor gyi snying po 'o: khroṃ ga ru ṭaḥtsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: khyung gi snying po 'o: zhes pa gtso bor bsnyen pa ste: 'bru 'bum la sogs thems par bya: de nas khro bcu'i bsnyen pa ni: khro bcu rang rang thugs kar nyi ma'i steng: hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng rang mdog g.yas su 'khor: sngags las 'od zer gnam lcags thog ltar 'phro:

khro chung mtshon thogs hūm̐ phaṭaḥsgra dang bcas: stong gsum rab tu gang bas gnod byed bdud: dgra bgegs byad ma rang gshed rang la dbab: sha khrag phye mar gtub cing lhag med gsol: lus ngag yid gsum thal ba'i rdul bzhin du: ming yang med par gtan nas brlags par bsam: oṃ badzra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ kā ra'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: rnam par rgyal ba'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta nī la daṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa: dbyug pa sngon po'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta ya mānta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: gshin rje'i gshed po'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta ārya a tsa la hūm̐ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: mi g.yo mgon po'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: rta mgrin rgyal po'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa: gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa: bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa: khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi snying po 'o: oṃ badzra kro ta ma hā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa: stobs chen rgyal po'i snying po 'o: zhes pa gnam lcags thog ltar bzla: gtso 'khor dril ba'i snying po ni: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta hya grī wa badzra pā ṇi khroṃ ga ru ṭaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: zhes pa gcig dril snying po 'o: gtso bo'i bsnyen pa stong tsho re'i: mjug tu khro bcu brgya re btags: phrin las gang 'dod rang rang bzhin: dmigs pa sngags gsham kha bsgyur ro: gong gi rtsa sngags gsum po ni: rab kyi 'bru stong 'bring 'bru khri: tha ma 'bru 'bum thems pa yis: 'grub par 'gyur ba the tshom med:

rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma yang: rmi lam zhal mjal gsung thos 'gyur: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun 'grub: sa ma yā: phrin las sngags sham rim pa ni: zhi ba la/ 'jigs pa brgyad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: 'byor pa drug puṣṭiṃ ku ru bhrūm̐ swā hā: dbang la: mos pa bzhi wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ swā hā: drag por bsgrub na: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: ces pa la sogs kha bsgyur te: gang che gtso dang bstun par bya: sa ma yā: tshogs kyi las rim ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i sa bon las: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros ye shes me rlung chus: dngos po bag chags gnyis 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus: slar yang 'bru gsum 'phros pas ye shes kyi: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon snang srid bkang: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag dbyings nas bde gshegs rgyal ba kun: 'dus pa'i bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: yi dam rta phyag khyung gsum gtso 'khor bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs su gsol zhing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sprul 'khor bcas: thugs rjes brtse phyir gnas 'dir bzhugs nas kyang: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: bdag cag dus gsum nyams chag bskang zhing bshags: gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i 'khrul snang ru tra 'di: gnyis med dbyings su sgrol la gsol cig rol: ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: zhes pas phul nas bskang ba 'don: lhag gtor: hūm̐ bhyo: mkha' 'gro dam can lhag la dbang ba rnams: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan dgra chos log gnod 'tshe bdud: mi mthun phyogs kun myur brlag phrin las mdzod: u tsiṣṭa bha liṃ ta la kha kha khā hi: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim las: dang po bskul ba bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs skur ston pa:
